summary_ja: 期待エクスポージャー方式の承認を受けた者が、申請書記載事項の変更・添付書類の重要な変更・承認基準の不充足が生じた場合に届け出ること、不充足の場合は改善計画を提出することを定める。
summary_en: An approved firm must notify the FSA of changes to its application, material changes to attachments, or any failure to meet the approval standards — the last with an improvement plan.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach that has received approval for the use of the expected exposure method shall, in any of the following cases, notify the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency of that fact and its details without delay. (i) Where there is a change in the matters stated in the application for approval. (ii) Where there is a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the application for approval. (iii) Where a circumstance has arisen in which the standards for approval provided in the items of the preceding Article are not satisfied.

When making a notification under item (iii) of the preceding paragraph, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall submit an improvement plan for the matters in which it does not satisfy the standards for approval, together with that notification or promptly thereafter.
